name: youtube-mcp
description: Paste a YouTube link and read its transcript, from the video's own or auto-generated captions. Read-only. No API key, no Google account, nothing to set up.

default_language.title: Preferred caption language (optional)
default_language.description: A language code such as es or en. Used when you don't ask for a language. Leave empty to get each video in the language it is spoken in.
